Good afternoon, Adrian. Rachel Lim speaking. Thanks for calling. Have you managed to get a quiet moment between your meetings? We can keep the conversation focused, and you can let me know if you need a pause.

Hi Rachel. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. It's been a busy morning with consulting work, but I've put aside some time for this call. My NRIC is S six five three two five three nine A. My date of birth is the sixteenth of May nineteen ninety-eight.

Thank you. I'll keep things concise. We can take the conversation in stages, rather than trying to cover everything in one stretch.

The fund I want to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund. I want to buy, please. I have 5,000 units in mind, but let me settle the details before committing to that quantity. I've got my notes in front of me, so I shouldn't need to search through anything while we're talking.

All right, I'll leave you room to refer to your notes as we talk. I recommend buying Nova Technology Equity Fund.

Okay, noted. Please use euros as the transaction currency. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 1,000,000. My earlier investment in this fund was 150,000 euros. That's just my budgeting history, not the amount for today's instruction.

For illustration only, a subscription of 100,000 euros would translate into units based on the applicable unit price. That example is not your current order amount.

All right. By the way, these telephone appointments are much easier to fit around work. A branch visit usually means rearranging meetings and allowing extra time for travelling.

Noted on the appointment format. Let me cover the next part of our conversation now. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology shares, so its value can swing sharply when sentiment towards that sector changes. Do you understand how that concentration in technology shares can cause sharp swings in the fund's value?

Yes, I understand. A change in sentiment towards technology shares can make the fund's value fluctuate sharply.

You could lose part or even all of the money you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and substantial fluctuations in value.

Thank you. On the scheduling side, would you prefer future telephone appointments to be arranged through you directly, rather than having us coordinate through your office?

Directly with me, please. My team handles the business diary, but I keep personal appointments separate. Sometimes a client meeting runs over, so a little flexibility helps.

Certainly. We can contact you directly about arranging appointments. If your work diary changes, just let us know and we can find another suitable slot.

Thanks, that would be helpful. I've finished looking through my notes now. For the final order, use the unit quantity I mentioned earlier. I'm committing to that quantity now. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 200 euros per unit.

Please confirm your final instruction: buy 5,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund, for an amount of 1,000,000 in euros, using a limit order at a limit price of 200 euros. Is that the instruction you want me to execute?

Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please proceed exactly as you have stated.

Thank you, Adrian. That brings us to the end of today's call. I'll let you get back to your afternoon. I hope the rest of your meetings run on time.

Thanks, Rachel. The next one is just with my own team, so at least there's no travelling involved. Appreciate you keeping the call focused. Have a good afternoon.

You're welcome. Thanks for making the time to speak today. Have a good afternoon too. Goodbye.

Thanks, goodbye.
